title: [MTR4] Mercedes E-citaro
description: This projet adds the Mercedes Benz eCitaro to Minecraft Transit Railway!
body:
## Mercedes Benz eCitaro The Mercedes Benz eCitaro is a standard (12 meter) electric bus used accross many capitals in Europe. With its low-floor, 3-door design, this bus is perfect for any high capacity urban routes!
This pack in particular adds the above model with many features that make it similar to its real life counterpart, such as: - **Working indicators:** the right indicator will **blink when the bus is at a stop** and, **prior to departure, the left indicator will blink**! - **Animated doors:** the front and rear doors are animated and open just like a normal bus door in order to give it some realism. The middle isn't animated because, in this particular model, these doors open outwards. ![eCitaro - Front view](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/HwrHCncj/images/f5261aedf63840e43d0a23095f9dc96f1489aa52.png) ## Retexturing this bus
Click to learn more about retexturing this bus! Would you like to retexture this bus for your own operator?
Feel free to contact me (by joining my [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/astMcchNdP) or sending me a DM from the MTR server) to be able to assist you :) This bus's textures are fairly easy to edit and should be pretty straight forward. Feel free to explore and ask for help if needed!
## Support, Issues and Suggestions If you find any issues in this pack, have any suggestions for improvement or need help setting this up, feel free to join my [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/astMcchNdP)! I (Movies22) also post sneak peeks of my upcoming packs there :) ## KNOWN ISSUES The bus's doors will bug out if you attempt to open them WITHOUT any platform block. As such, **make sure** that you only open this bus's doors **when standing at a stop with a platform**. ## Disclaimer This pack is not associated with **Mercedes Benz**.
